tools.name: propose_answer_program
tools.description: Testing stage. Submit a Python program defining transform(grid) -> grid that implements the rule. It is run on every input-output pair you have seen in this trial and each miss is reported with cell coordinates. When it reproduces all of them exactly, it is run on the test input and that output is submitted as your answer. Standard library only.

output_items.name: propose_answer_program

tool_calls.name: propose_answer_program

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # locate the solid horizontal sides of the framed panel
    candidates=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=0:
            candidates.append((r,grid[r][0]))
    if len(candidates)>=2:
        top,col=candidates[0]; bot=next((r for r,c in candidates[1:] if c==col),candidates[1][0])
        # columns occupied by the vertical sides throughout the interval
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[top][c]==col and grid[bot][c]==col]
        left,right=min(cs),max(cs)
        return [row[left+1:right] for row in grid[top+1:bot]]
    return grid"}
